scope: Only multi-boundary-v02 repair and all four repair perimeters; not formal acceptance of full tiles or map.
method: Viewed all four native perimeter before/after images and six additional unresampled crops including the previous v01 failure areas. Existing assembly provenance validation was not rerun.

resolved.description: The original dark rectangle is removed in the native repair; v02 retains its selection in the mandatory center region.
The original straight tile-boundary color change through blue roof tiles and wooden beam remains corrected; no new large silhouette break appears at that tile join.
The v01 wavy vertical brightness boundary and small stepped bevel transitions are absent after moving the selection perimeter to the whole repair extent.
The v01 curved/jagged patch edge above/right of the red diamond is absent.

perimeterReview.description: Blue-tile slopes/rims and gold roof ornament retain connected contours; no conspicuous new straight or rectangular edge seen.
Roof tile, wooden bracket, long gold-trimmed beam and door panel transition continuously across this perimeter; no v01-level brightness seam or bevel step seen.
Wall texture and red/gold framed decoration remain continuous; no conspicuous external edge or misaligned frame observed.

The broad door-panel patch boundary is gone. The red diamond edge remains connected. A short low-amplitude wood-tone change near the vertical door molding remains visible on close inspection, without a corresponding silhouette break.

minorNotes.description: Short wood-tone turn close to an existing vertical door molding; much smaller and lower contrast than v01's patch boundary. Does not justify further full-object repaint based on this review.

recommendation: Use v02 instead of v01 for this local boundary repair. Retain the minor texture note. Continue normal wider tile and neighbor QA; do not equate this local pass with formal tile/map acceptance.
limitations: Visual review is local to the repair and its perimeters.
Approximate diagnostic defect bounds do not alter art coordinates.
